description: This file defines the ext_rest_facebook class that extends ext_rest, implementing a connector module for Facebook integration within SuiteCRM. It includes configuration settings, module filtering, and stub methods for fetching data.

classes.name: ext_rest_facebook
classes.description: A class that extends ext_rest to provide Facebook-specific connector functionality, including module filtering and data retrieval stubs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the Facebook connector with specific properties, such as allowed modules and testing flags.

methods.name: filterAllowedModules
methods.description: Filters the input list of modules to only include those permitted for Facebook integration, namely Accounts, Contacts, and Leads.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve a single item from Facebook; currently returns null.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve a list of items from Facebook; currently returns null.
